info.description: REST API of LinguaFlow, an AI-powered personalized language learning platform. Errors are returned as RFC 7807 application/problem+json with a stable `code` field.
info.title: LinguaFlow API

get.description: LLM calls, failures, tokens and estimated cost across all users, by use case, model and UTC day, plus the users with the highest cost. Covers at most 366 days.

parameters.description: First UTC day, inclusive (default: 29 days before to)
parameters.name: from

get.description: Your AI jobs, newest first. Sortable by createdAt, updatedAt.
Counts by status for up to 100 jobs, e.g. the batches of one bulk add. Poll until finished is true.
Poll every few seconds until finished is true. A QUEUED job with waiting set is retrying after a temporary problem (RETRY) or waiting for the daily AI allowance (DAILY_LIMIT), until nextRunAt.
Calls and tokens used today (UTC) against the daily limits. When the allowance is used up, new AI work such as enriching words waits until resetsAt.

post.description: Returns a short-lived access token and sets the HttpOnly refresh-token cookie (path /api/auth).

429.description: Too many login attempts from this IP (code TOO_MANY_REQUESTS; see Retry-After)

post.description: Revokes the refresh-token session and clears the cookie. Idempotent.
Logs the user out on all devices.

400.description: Invalid, expired or used link (code INVALID_TOKEN), or the password does not meet the policy (code VALIDATION_FAILED)

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset link

post.description: Always 202, whether or not the email is registered, so accounts cannot be discovered.

202.description: If the account exists, a link was sent

429.description: Too many reset requests from this IP (code TOO_MANY_REQUESTS)

post.description: Uses and rotates the refresh-token cookie. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the whole login session.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or reused refresh token (code INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN)

post.description: Does not log the user in; call /api/auth/login next.

429.description: Too many registrations from this IP (code TOO_MANY_REQUESTS; see Retry-After)

400.description: Invalid, expired or used link (code INVALID_TOKEN)

post.summary: Confirm the email address with the token from the verification link

202.description: Sent (or nothing to do: already verified)

post.summary: Send a new email verification link to the current user

get.description: Topics of the active language, newest first by default. Repeating a filter means any of them. Sortable by: createdAt, updatedAt, title, cefrLevel, status.

parameters.description: Text in the title or description
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Only topics of this study session
parameters.name: sessionId

post.description: Added to the active language. A title you already have (ignoring case, spacing, a leading article and ß/ss) is rejected with 409 and its existingId.

409.description: Already one of your topics (code GRAMMAR_TOPIC_DUPLICATE, see existingId), or no active language yet (code NO_ACTIVE_LANGUAGE)

get.description: The catalog of the active language, by level then title, with the topics you already have marked. Repeat cefrLevel for several levels.

post.description: Adds the entry as one of your topics, with its title, description and level, in the active language. The body is optional.

409.description: You already have a topic with that title (code GRAMMAR_TOPIC_DUPLICATE, see existingId)

delete.description: Also deletes its status history and progress.

patch.description: Partial update. Status changes are recorded in the status history.

409.description: The new title clashes with another topic (code GRAMMAR_TOPIC_DUPLICATE, see existingId), or the topic was changed meanwhile (code CONFLICT)

get.summary: Status history of a grammar topic
List all languages and what they can be used for

get.description: Sessions of the active language, most recent lesson first. Sortable by studiedOn, createdAt, updatedAt, title.
The session new words and topics join; 204 when none is active.
Your lessons in the active language grouped by month, most recent first, with how many words and grammar topics each covered. Optionally limited to lessons studied from and/or to a date (inclusive).

delete.description: Its words and topics stay in your collection.

409.description: The session was changed meanwhile (code CONFLICT)

200.description: The session with its new counts

get.description: IDs of its words and topics, e.g. for Current Lesson practice. For the full words and topics, filter the lists by sessionId.

200.description: The session with its new counts

get.description: All tags of the active language, by name, with word counts.

409.description: A tag with that name exists (code TAG_NAME_TAKEN, see existingId), or no active language yet (code NO_ACTIVE_LANGUAGE)

delete.description: The words stay; they just lose this tag.

409.description: Another tag has that name (code TAG_NAME_TAKEN, see existingId)

delete.description: Permanent. Requires the password. Clears the refresh cookie.
delete.summary: Delete the account and all its data

patch.description: Only the fields present in the body are changed.
patch.summary: Update display name, interface language and/or time zone

get.summary: List the languages the current user learns

post.description: The first language becomes active automatically; pass active=true to switch to it.

delete.description: Permanently deletes ALL learning data for this language (vocabulary, grammar, sessions, reviews, progress). Clients must ask for confirmation first.

patch.description: Partial update: absent fields (including fields inside settings) stay unchanged.
patch.summary: Change explanation language, level or learning settings, or make this the active language

put.description: Logs out every other device. Returns a fresh access token and sets a new refresh cookie, so this client stays logged in.

400.description: Current password incorrect, new password unchanged or too weak (code VALIDATION_FAILED, see errors[].field)

get.description: Words in the active language, newest first by default. Filters combine with AND; repeating a filter (e.g. status=NEW&status=LEARNING) means any of them. Sortable by: createdAt, updatedAt, lemma, translation, cefrLevel, status.

parameters.description: Text in the lemma (article, case and ß/ss ignored) or the translation
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Only words of this study session
parameters.name: sessionId

parameters.description: Only words in these AI enrichment states, e.g. PENDING_AI
parameters.name: aiStatus

post.description: Added to the active language. A word you already have (same lemma ignoring article, case and ß/ss, and the same part of speech or none on either side) is rejected with 409 and its existingId.

409.description: Already in your vocabulary (code VOCABULARY_DUPLICATE, see existingId), or no active language yet (code NO_ACTIVE_LANGUAGE)

post.description: Parses pasted text or CSV and reports each line as NEW, DUPLICATE (of a word you have, or of an earlier line) or INVALID. Nothing is saved; confirm the lines to keep. A line without a part of speech counts as a duplicate of any word with the same lemma.
Adds each item to the active language on its own, so one failure doesn't stop the rest. Items that are duplicates by now are reported, not added. New words await AI enrichment.

200.description: One result per item, in request order

get.description: Words of the active language, oldest first, with the same filters as the list. Columns: lemma, translation, partOfSpeech, gender, plural, cefrLevel, status, notes, tags (names separated by |). UTF-8 with a byte order mark, so spreadsheets detect the encoding.

parameters.description: Text in the lemma or the translation
parameters.name: q

post.description: A UTF-8 CSV file (comma or semicolon) with a header row naming any of the export's columns; lemma is required. Adds each row to the active language on its own and reports it. Words you already have (same lemma and part of speech) are skipped; tags are matched by name and created when missing; MASTERED is imported as LEARNED. At most 2000 rows and 2 MB.

200.description: One result per data row, in file order

delete.description: Also deletes its examples, flashcards and progress.

patch.description: Partial update. Fields you edit stop counting as AI-generated.

409.description: The new lemma clashes with another word (code VOCABULARY_DUPLICATE, see existingId), or the word was changed meanwhile (code CONFLICT)

post.description: Clears every value the AI filled in and its examples, then queues a fresh enrichment that doesn't reuse earlier answers. Your own values, examples and the part of speech stay; change the part of speech first if it's wrong. Follow the job with GET /api/ai/jobs/{aiJobId}.

202.description: The word is waiting for AI again

409.description: AI is still working on the word (code CONFLICT)

status.description: Defaults to NEW; MASTERED is earned, not set

active.description: Make it the active language (the first language always becomes active)

AiJob.description: Background AI work, e.g. enriching a batch of words

finished.description: SUCCEEDED, FAILED or DEAD: the job won't change any more

nextRunAt.description: When a QUEUED job runs next

result.description: What the job produced, once SUCCEEDED; its shape depends on the type

waiting.description: Only for a QUEUED job that has already been tried or postponed

AiJobProgress.description: How far a set of jobs has got, e.g. the batches of one bulk add. Jobs that don't exist or aren't yours are listed in notFound and counted nowhere else.

finished.description: True once every found job is SUCCEEDED, FAILED or DEAD

AiUsageSummary.description: AI usage across all users for a range of UTC days

byDay.description: Only days with calls, oldest first

topUsers.description: Up to 10 users by estimated cost

AiUsageTotals.description: LLM calls and their estimated cost

costUsd.description: Estimated cost in USD; calls to models without a price count as 0

ApiProblem.description: RFC 7807 problem details returned for every error

correlationId.description: ID of the request; quote it when reporting problems

detail.example: One or more fields are invalid

errors.description: Present for VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per invalid field

existingId.description: Present for VOCABULARY_DUPLICATE, TAG_NAME_TAKEN and GRAMMAR_TOPIC_DUPLICATE: ID of the word, tag or topic that already exists

tagIds.description: Tags to put on every added word

BulkVocabularyItem.description: A previewed line the learner kept, possibly edited

existingId.description: DUPLICATE: the word you already have

duplicateOfLine.description: DUPLICATE of an earlier line of this input: its line

existingId.description: DUPLICATE of a word you have: its ID

line.description: 1-based line in the input; blank lines are counted

message.description: Why the line is DUPLICATE or INVALID

text.description: TEXT: one word per line, optionally 'word - translation' (also '=', tab, en or em dash). CSV: comma or semicolon separated; columns lemma, translation, or any order with a header row naming lemma|word, translation, partOfSpeech|pos, cefrLevel|level, notes. At most 500 lines.
text.example:
der Hund - dog
die Katze - cat
laufen

aiJobIds.description: AI jobs enriching the new words, in batches; follow them with GET /api/ai/jobs/progress

newPassword.description: At least 10 characters, at most 72 bytes

status.description: Defaults to NEW; MASTERED is earned, not set

active.description: Make it the active session, so new words and topics join it; ends any other active session

studiedOn.description: Defaults to today in your time zone

CreateVocabularyRequest.description: Only lemma is required; missing details are filled in by AI enrichment later

lemma.description: The word or phrase as you want to see it, article included

status.description: Defaults to LEARNING; MASTERED is earned, not set

tagIds.description: IDs of your tags in the same language

FieldError.description: Present for VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per invalid field

topicId.description: Your topic for this entry, if you already have it (picked from here or with the same title); null if you can add it

catalogTopicId.description: Catalog entry it was picked from (GRM-03)

reason.description: CREATED, MANUAL (by you), MASTERY_RULE or DEMOTION_RULE (by your progress)

supportedAsExplanation.description: Can be used for translations and explanations

dailyReviewGoal.description: Target number of reviews per day

newCardsPerDay.description: Maximum new flashcards introduced per day

preferredExerciseTypes.description: Preferred exercise formats; empty = no preference

MyAiUsage.description: The caller's AI usage today (UTC) and the daily limits

exceeded.description: Whether today's allowance is used up; new AI work waits until resetsAt

password.description: At least 10 characters, at most 72 bytes

newPassword.description: At least 10 characters, at most 72 bytes

preferredExerciseTypes.description: Empty list = no preference; duplicates are ignored

active.description: New words and topics join the active session

StudySessionMaterial.description: IDs of the session's material, in the order it was added

StudySessionTimeline.description: Counts are attachments: a word studied in two lessons counts in both

name.description: 1–50 characters; must be unique ignoring case

UpdateGrammarTopicRequest.description: Partial update: absent or null fields stay unchanged; an empty string clears the description or notes

confirmMastered.description: Set to true to mark the topic MASTERED by hand

status.description: LEARNING or LEARNED; MASTERED only with confirmMastered (it is normally earned through practice); NEW can't be chosen again

active.description: true = make this the active language

interfaceLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code of a supported language

timezone.description: IANA time zone; defines the user's today for reviews and streaks

UpdateStudySessionRequest.description: Partial update: absent or null fields stay unchanged; an empty string clears the notes

active.description: true makes it the active session (ending any other); false ends it

UpdateVocabularyRequest.description: Partial update: absent or null fields stay unchanged; an empty string clears a text field

clear.description: Fields to clear, which an empty string can't express

examples.description: Replaces all examples, in this order; an empty list removes them. Send an example's id back unchanged to keep it marked as AI-generated

status.description: MASTERED can't be set; it is earned through practice

tagIds.description: Replaces the word's tags; an empty list removes them all

verbForms.description: Sets a verb's principal parts; only for verbs

id.description: The example's id, when it's an existing one

aiJobIds.description: AI jobs enriching the imported words, in batches

createdTagCount.description: Tags the file named that you didn't have yet

existingId.description: DUPLICATE: the word you already have

message.description: Why the row is DUPLICATE or INVALID, or what was changed on import

aiGeneratedFields.description: Fields whose current value came from AI

article.description: Definite article, derived from gender for German nouns

extra.description: Word-type data, e.g. verbs: praeteritum, partizip2, auxiliary

VocabularyRegenerateResult.description: The word, back to PENDING_AI, and the AI job filling it in

wordCount.description: How many of your words carry this tag
